title: Historical Chess Games
text:
Introduction
A compilation of historically significant chess games for pedagogical purposes.
It is companion to my transcription of Philidor’s Analysis of the Game of Chess.
The brief descriptions of each game were taken directly from Wikipedia’s List of chess games.

title: The games
text:
The early game
51 games, 1475 to 2023, oldest first. Every one of them has been replayed move by move on a board before being published here, and every one names the source its moves were read from.
Chess before the tournament: games recorded because someone thought them worth writing down.

1475 · Francesco di Castellvi vs Narciso Vinyoles, 1475
Where each game’s moves were read from. Nothing here is a reconstruction: the moves were taken from a published record, replayed on a board to check that every one of them is legal, and cross-checked against the result the source reports. Where two sources disagreed, both are listed and the chapter says so.
The notes are written for this book unless the note says whose judgement it is reporting. Where a note carries a name, that name is the person the assessment belongs to, and the source it was read in is listed with the game.
